summary: Stage Nightlands comfort-loop playtest using new multi-layer overlays
context: With targeted sync automation in flight and a joint Music + Lore vignette defined, we need real player feedback to inform the next campaign arc. A focused comfort-loop playtest will validate ops readiness, gather qualitative observations, and surface any regression gaps before we scale.

directives.details: Identify 2-3 operators or trusted testers and brief them on the joint overlay scenario, cooldown expectations, and targeted sync tooling. Capture their consent in the ledger.
Facilitate a comfort-loop play session covering dispatch, overlays, targeted sync, and evidence review. Use the new tooling and storyboard end-to-end.
Record qualitative feedback, session metrics (duration, number of overlay triggers, sync invocations), and any friction points. Archive session logs in logs/alfa_zero/play_session_feedback/.
Summarize findings in planning/campaigns_and_lulls.md and planning/alfa_zero_targeted_sync_scope.md, highlighting readiness, blockers, and morale signals.
From the playtest insights, draft follow-on recommendations (orders or enhancements) and attach them to the completion report for review.

success_criteria: Playtest cohort confirmed and briefed with ledger entries.
Joint overlay scenario executed end-to-end using the new tooling.
Feedback and metrics archived with clear references to logs and evidence.
Campaign documentation reflects readiness signals and identified gaps.
Completion report proposes concrete next orders or enhancements.
